items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: myself and Polito Vega are the only ones that are playing Machito recordings

ctx.x: Gee, I never keep track, really.

Okay, I know it runs into about fifty or around that area. Now, with all these recordings that are out there, why haven't disk jockeys played some of your recordings? You know, we have a lot of Latin music now, not enough Latin music on the air now, but more than we've had any other time before. We have Roger Dawson, we have - myself and Polito Vega are the only ones that are playing Machito recordings. Why haven't the other ones played them, Macho? Does it bother you?
